title: U.S. commander calls mental health a priority after he visits USS Lincoln
summary_full: Amid reports of burnout and poor conditions on the USS Abraham Lincoln, Adm. Brad Cooper acknowledged that long stretches at sea can be challenging but said some of the concerns were "old news."
